##  Hello and welcome! 

My name is Alex and I am currently pursuing a Master of Data Science (MDS) at the University of British Columbia (UBC). I also hold a Bachelor's degree from UBC majoring in Economics and Statistics. 

Prior to joining MDS, I have spent three and a half years at Deloitte Vancouver's Transfer Pricing practice where I assisted multinational companies develop and defend pricing strategies for their cross-border intercompany transactions.  

Outside of work and school, I enjoy playing soccer, snowboarding, and practicing latte art.

### 🔧 Skills
- **Languages**: Python, R, SQL
- **Data Science Libraries**: Pandas, Numpy, scikit-learn, PyTorch, XGBoost
- **Development & Deployment**: Git, Docker, AWS (EC2, S3, EMR, SageMaker)
